newsitem.title: POLAND: LOT to launch new flights to UK.
newsitem.headline: LOT to launch new flights to UK.

text.p: Poland's national air-carrier PLL LOT will launch new connections to the UK, from Warsaw to Manchester and from Krakow to London-Gatwick starting from 1997 summer season, LOT's trade director said on Tuesday.
Krzysztof Ziebinski told a news conference LOT was also increasing the number of flights from Warsaw to London-Heathrow to 16 per week in the summer season, from 13 at present.

He said the new flights from Warsaw to Manchester would start on April 14 and from Krakow to London from April 1. In the 1997 summer season LOT will offer 24 total connections bewteen Poland and Great Britain.
